notes: Mages City accepts the two most protective service-delivery agreements of the IEEE 7012 roster. No third-party tracking: no analytics, tracking, profiling or sharing of members' data with anyone but the community itself; data portability on request. Mages City is a member of the MyTerms alliance. This is the City's statement of what it accepts, not a claim of IEEE 7012 conformance.
